name: Daily Email

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "30 3 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  send-email:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '21'

      - name: Build project
        run: mvn clean install

      - name: Run app
        run: java -jar target/March22-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar
        env:
          SPRING_MAIL_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.MAIL_USERNAME }}
          SPRING_MAIL_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MAIL_PASSWORD }}
